annotation.title_clean: Stratégie nationale de développement de la mobilité routière automatisée et connectée 2022-2025 : État des lieux, enjeux et actions
annotation.title_en: National Strategy for Automated and Connected Road Mobility 2022-2025: Status, Issues and Actions
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Gouvernement français (ministères de la transition écologique, de l'économie, de l'intérieur, des transports, de l'industrie et du numérique)
annotation.summary_en: The 2022-2025 update of France's strategy for automated and connected road mobility shifts focus from vehicles to mobility services. It reviews the LOM-based legal framework, EU type-approval and the Vienna Convention amendment. It sets four priority actions: connectivity and data, funding, local-authority support, and a legal framework for automated freight.
key_provisions_or_claims: Four priority actions: connectivity/data, investment financing, support for local authorities, and automated freight/logistics legal framework
Principles of safety, progressivity and acceptability remain in force
Target of 100-500 driverless passenger services by 2030
France claims the most complete G7 legal framework for driver-delegation vehicles (LOM 2019, ordinance 2021, decree 2021)
Funding programmes include France 2030, Confiance.ai (45M€) and Prissma
